escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{escape_asterisks: true, escape_underscores: false}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
